flow-definition.description: Builds driver packages for Lenovo Systems.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: MACHINE_TYPE
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: List of Lenovo machine type codes (comma separated

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: UPDATE_TYPE
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Valid values are Application, Driver, Bios, Firmware

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: REBOOT_TYPE
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Valid values are: 'Forced reboot', 'Requires reboot', 'Forces shutdown', 'Delayed forced reboot'

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: SEVERITY
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Valid values are: Critical, Recommended, Other

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: CATEGORY
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Category of driver to package. Valid values: 'Audio', 'Bluetooth and Modem', 'Camera and Card Reader', 'Display and Video Graphics', 'Docking Station and Port Replicator', 'Fingerprint reader', 'Motherboard Devices Backplanes core chipset onboard video PCIe switches', 'Mouse Pen and Keyboard,' 'Networking Wireless LAN', 'Networking Wireless WAN', 'Power Management', 'Software and Utilities', 'Storage', 'USB Device FireWire IEEE 1394 Thunderbolt'
